All tokio-util tests pass (26 test binaries, 0 failures), including the failing `wake_after_remove_last`.

Fix: in `DelayQueue::remove` (tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs:857), when removing an item leaves the wheel empty (`next_deadline == None`), the stored waker is now woken and `self.delay` cleared, so a task blocked in `poll_expired` returns `Poll::Ready(None)` instead of hanging forever.
